description: This file is an HTML document serving as the frontend interface for a database viewer web application. It contains styled HTML elements, JavaScript code for fetching and displaying database information and table data, and user interaction logic.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets the UI state, and triggers data reload.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables, loads tables if needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs an HTML table from data and inserts into the DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, large texts, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for full viewing.
